name: OpenSky Network
description: OpenSky live state vectors, receiver states, recent flight history, airport arrivals/departures, and aircraft tracks. Intended for research and non-commercial use; commercial use requires OpenSky consent.

credential_fields.name: client_id
credential_fields.label: OAuth Client ID
credential_fields.description: API client ID created on the OpenSky account page.

credential_fields.name: client_secret
credential_fields.label: OAuth Client Secret
credential_fields.description: Secret for the OpenSky API client.

tools.name: get_states
tools.description: Get live/recent aircraft state vectors. Filter by ICAO24 identifiers or a complete geographic bounding box to reduce credit use. State rows contain position, altitude, velocity, track, vertical rate, squawk, and category.

time.description: Unix seconds; authenticated access supports up to one hour in the past.

icao24.description: ICAO24 hex identifiers; sent as repeated query parameters.

tools.name: get_own_receiver_states
tools.description: Get live states observed by receivers belonging to the authenticated account. This endpoint does not consume normal state-vector credits.

tools.name: list_flights
tools.description: List flights that departed or arrived in a Unix-time interval no longer than two hours.

tools.name: list_aircraft_flights
tools.description: List completed flights for one aircraft in an interval no longer than two days. Flight history is batch-updated, not live schedule data.

tools.name: list_airport_arrivals
tools.description: List completed arrivals for an ICAO airport and interval no longer than two days. Results are batch-updated.

tools.name: list_airport_departures
tools.description: List completed departures for an ICAO airport and interval no longer than two days. Results are batch-updated.

tools.name: get_aircraft_track
tools.description: Get an experimental waypoint trajectory for an aircraft at a Unix timestamp; use time=0 for the current flight. Tracks older than 30 days are unavailable.
